_note: picks: which numbered candidate in _src/garden-candidates/<crop>/ to serve, and the alt text for it. items: which crop photograph a planting guide entry uses. An entry with no crop, or a crop with no pick, shows the empty window, which is the site's empty state and not a failure. Add to either side and run scripts/build-garden-photos.mjs again.

tomatoes: A staked tomato plant carrying green fruit, with yellow blossom hanging open on the same stem.
okra: An okra pod standing straight up off the stem with the spent flower still hanging from its tip.
collards: Two gloved hands reaching into the middle of a collard plant, the broad ribbed leaves filling the frame.
corn: A short block of sweet corn in full tassel at the edge of a worked garden.
sweetpotato: Sweet potatoes lying on the ground where they were just turned up, still attached to the vine.
garlic: A garlic bulb with the papery outer skin opened back to show the cloves inside.
radishes: A red radish half lifted out of dark soil with its leaves still on it.
southernpeas: Long cowpea pods hanging in a bunch from the vine among the leaves.
covercrop: A cover crop coming up green in rows through the stubble of a cut corn field.
